trailhead.name: Mount Persis trailhead (pullout near FR 62 / FR 6220 road end)

identifiedBy.fact: WTA lists only one access for Persis: FR 62 then FR 6220 to a pullout near the road end; the route's own text names FR 6220 / Anderson Creek

otherFacts.value: FR 62 about 3.5 mi to FR 6220 junction, then about 2 mi rough road; may not suit passenger cars
Hampton Resources recreation permit needed for private land access

notes: WEAK / peak-level: no page about the Hexorcist or the north face found (2 searches, no hits for the name). WTA page (opened) is the West Ridge hike, names a single road access, no other trailhead; route's own text also names FR 6220. Mountaineers Persis page 403.

trailhead.name: Depot Creek Trailhead (BC, off Chilliwack Lake Road)

identifiedBy.fact: Car at Depot Creek TH 2300 ft, about 5.5 mi past border swath to Ouzel Lake camp, then Rahm SW route, traverse to Custer, descent of Custer South Ridge

otherFacts.value: lake to Rahm 3:20, Rahm to Custer 2:45, Custer to lake 2:00
Ouzel Lake 5700 ft, about 6 h from car
North Cascades NP permit required, can be called in
locked gate on Depot Creek Road near 0.9 mi (2021 update); drive up to about 150 ft from border swath

notes: Opened stephabegg page: Depot Creek TH. No coordinate printed; official candidates are other BC trailheads, none matches. Mountaineers trip report and SummitPost 403. Same start as earlier pass.

otherFacts.value: 1967 central Mowich Face first ascent started at car at St. Andrews Creek on Westside Road (not this route)

identifiedBy.fact: South Tahoma Headwall ski descent ended on the lower Tahoma Glacier, South Puyallup Trail and the west side road; route's own text names the Dry Creek gate walk

otherFacts.value: Andy Bond solo, 2011-05-04, via Gibraltar Ledges to Point Success
Dry Creek to South Puyallup TH about 4.2 mi; St. Andrews Creek TH about 7.2 mi

notes: WEAK: start is the route's own text; the opened ski report is a descent that ended on Westside Road, not an approach, and the headwall can also be reached from Camp Muir. NPS Dry Creek page prints no coordinate. WTA Westside Road page prints 46.7424,-121.8995 for the road hike but does not say it is the Dry Creek lot (likely the road junction), so not used as a placement. Peak is Rainier (id says glacier_peak).

identifiedBy.fact: From Westside Road - Dry Creek Trailhead, walk closed road past barricade to Tahoma Creek Trail

otherFacts.value: small lot south of barricade, 3 mi from road start, vehicles must park south of barricade; open to cars about May-Nov

notes: Opened NPS Dry Creek page confirms the lot and gate; no coordinate printed. No page found about Tahoma Cleaver itself (search surfaced Success Cleaver, same Westside Road approach, via snippets only). WTA Westside Road coordinate 46.7424,-121.8995 not tied to the Dry Creek lot, not used.

nothing new. Route's own text names a Ruth Creek Road pullout near milepost 3 (FS 32) before crossing Ruth Creek to Wall Street couloir. 1 search; SummitPost and CascadeClimbers 403, so no route page opened. A search snippet says a climber's log started from the Hannegan Pass trailhead, unopened, so the start is unconfirmed and a conflict is possible. USFS Hannegan Trailhead (48.910191,-121.591986) is the road end, not the pullout. No coordinate for the pullout.

identifiedBy.fact: 2006 and 2016 North Ridge parties left the Stuart Lake / Colchuck Lake trailhead, took the Mountaineer Creek climbers' trail to the base of the north ridge

otherFacts.value: 2016 car-to-car to summit 9h56; base about 3.2 h from car

notes: Page covers the Complete North Ridge incl. the Direct (not a page solely on the Direct). CAVEAT: the same page also logs a later car-to-car climb from Esmeralda Trailhead via Lake Ingalls and Goat Pass reaching the base in 4h42 (south approach), so a second start is in use; the Stuart Lake start is the usual one for the north-side ridge. Only 2 of 3 reports use Stuart Lake.

otherFacts.value: West Face wall, midway between Stuart Pass and Goat Pass; 9 pitches, 5.11-, FA 2009/2010

notes: Two starts reach the base: Esmeralda via Lake Ingalls and Goat Pass (stephabegg shows this approach to Stuart's base), or Stuart Lake via Stuart Pass. Opened MP route text (text only) and Alpinist newswire: neither names a trailhead. CascadeClimbers TRs 403. A search summary said the Ingalls Lake / Stuart Pass approach, unopened. Candidates: Esmeralda (47.436706,-120.936915), Stuart Lake (47.527806,-120.820515).

otherFacts.value: Stuart, Sherpa, Argonaut, Colchuck, Dragontail; 40 pitches Grade V
